setup.title: Welcome to Wally
setup.subtitle: Two quick choices and you’re in.
setup.currencyHint: Used for your dashboard and net-worth totals. You can change it later in Settings.

welcome.title: Welcome to Wally
welcome.body: Wally keeps your accounts, spending and investments in one place. Here’s a quick tour of the parts you’ll use most.

dashboard.title: Your net worth, up top
dashboard.body: This card adds every account and investment into one figure, with the month’s income and spending right below it.

log.title: Log as you go
log.body: This button opens the quick-add sheet for an income, expense or transfer. Log something daily and your streak keeps climbing.

logHow.title: Recording a transaction
logHow.body: In the sheet: pick income, expense or transfer, type the amount, choose the account and a category, then save. It takes a few seconds.

grow.title: Move around from here
grow.body: Use the navigation to jump between your dashboard, accounts, portfolio and analytics.

menu.title: The menu button
menu.body: Tap the ☰ button, top-left, for the full menu — settings, the theme shop, patch notes and sign-out. You can also swipe in from the left edge.

personalize.title: Make it yours
personalize.body: Change language or theme in Settings, and unlock themes from the Shop. You can replay this guide any time from Settings.
